# Mined: 2026-09-11. DERIVED, not mined: every 500th word at ranks 20,001-79,999 of the embedded wordlist, taken by fixed stride, not hand-picked. This exists to give HardReachable-tier coverage real breadth: it is words genuinely present in general English, but rare enough to be absent from the wordlist at typical wordlist_size cutoffs and present again only near the full 80k depth — exactly the definition tiers.rs uses for HardReachable.
# The harness (tests/injection_harness/tiers.rs) computes difficulty tier from the
# surface itself, at fixed wordlist depth — it is never read from this file.
